persons.name: Vajradhara
persons.evidence: lekhyaṃ śrīvajradhareṇa yā likhitapustaka saṃti tādṛṣṭa likhitaṃ mayā

date.as_written: śrīman nepālasambat caturanavanava māsakṛṣṇe ca āśvina tat kṛṣṇāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhitithau paridivaśivabhaṃ siddhiyogaś ca ghasro tat ghasro vāra śukre ravinivasa tulārāśi mithune candra

notes: The year 'caturanavanava' is interpreted as 994 NS.
